text:
olga: quick idea  we should publish a compact deprecation playbook (1-pager) for CSMs that maps model-delta -> action. needs to be prescriptive: pin, simulate, offer credit, or emergency rollback.
pavan: agree. keep it lightweight: decision tree with 4 outcomes. also add a short script CSMs can paste that triggers the simulator and creates the ticket.
qi: metrics to compute in simulator: embed shift (mean/median cosine), sample quality delta (golden set), p95 latency delta, and token-cost delta. produce an overall signal score 0-1.
rosa: customer-facing pieces: 1) advisory template 2) in-console banner wording 3) migration FAQ. keep comms plain: "we detected a change; here is your preview". include opt-out links.
sylvia: infra needs: model metadata flags: allow_auto_migrate (bool), soft_alias_target (string), deprecation_window_days (int). also an audit field migration_decision_id.
olga: policy: default = auto-migrate for non-enterprise with risk_score <=0.15; CSM-assisted for 0.15-0.45; block + eng review >0.45. credits: tiered by spend band, capped at $5000 per incident.
pavan: canary plan: 1% mirrored replay for 24h -> quick checks -> 5% live traffic for 72h if green. rollback conditions: quality_drop >2% OR embed_sim_mean <0.9 OR cost_increase >30%.
qi: add a "compat shim" option: small input-normalization layer that preserves tokenization semantics for legacy clients. only for cases where tokenization drift causes regressions. needs engineering sign-off.
rosa: CSM workflow: simulator report attaches to ticket with recommended options: auto-migrate + credit, schedule migration, or request exception. include sample diffs and a short summary sentence for execs.
sylvia: security/privacy: PII must be redacted before storing snapshots. provide a tenant opt-out toggle. simulator snapshots TTL = 60d. logs: store only hashed inputs.
ops-bot: deploy queued: model-catalog@staging with schema v3.2 (adds allow_auto_migrate, soft_alias_target, migration_decision_id).
olga: owners: olga (playbook + comms), pavan (canary + runtime), qi (simulator + metrics), rosa (CS templates), sylvia (infra + privacy). goal: ship MVP playbook + simulator endpoint in 3 sprints.
pavan: I'll prototype the CSM script (`/simulate_migration --tenant $TENANT_ID --model $MODEL_ID --sample 1pct`) and attach sample output.
qi: will wire risk_score and publish the score formula in the playbook. also add a short appendix on interpreting embed-sim percentiles.
rosa: I'll draft the 1-pager and the three comm templates this week.
olga: schedule review Thu 3pm. aim for a concise runbook so CSMs can act without waiting on eng. :calendar:
